temperature: Use the raw METAR T group when present and consistent; otherwise the main Celsius temperature group.
rounding: Convert Celsius to market units, then round to a whole degree, with exact halves toward positive infinity, matching weather.gov WRH table Math.round. Historical policies retain their original rounding.
day: Airport local calendar day, including DST transitions.
corrections: Highest explicit correction rank within each source, then its latest supported per-report receipt time. Preserve all versions. Never use local fetch order or file modification time.
cross_source_conflicts: Select by source order and display the disagreement; a selected reading does not require human review.
finalization: Lock at the first publication by this site of an eligible selected routine METAR for the following airport-local date, or 23:59:00 America/New_York on the calendar date following the observation date, whichever comes first. Only reports durably accepted strictly before cutoff enter the result. Later revisions cannot change a locked day.
unknown_classification: Exclude, retain and explain. Never infer routine status from a scheduled minute.

source_timing.noaa_awc: receiptTime from the original AWC JSON; preserve subsecond precision.

unresolved_revisions: Equal-time or unorderable conflicting versions block selection at that source, without fallback past the ambiguity. Matching legacy copies do not create a second unknown version.
nil_reports: A NIL report is ineligible and retained. Only an explicitly corrected NIL (COR token or CCx bulletin) withdraws a reading at its source; a plain NIL is a relay placeholder that neither withdraws nor competes with a routine report.
